subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Behind every image, song, or article is someone's time and skill.”?
options: Saving water was serious work, but the song made the message simple enough for everyone to carry.
Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.
Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.
Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Behind every image, song, or article is someone's time and skill. Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.」，答案為「Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.」。
